description: Representative visual validation samples for MIT-BIH AAMI EC57 classes

N.characteristics: Prominent R-peak at t=0ms, sharp Q and S waves, normal P-wave at -150ms, positive upright T-wave at +140ms.

S.characteristics: Narrow normal-duration QRS complex, premature abnormal P' morphology superimposed on preceding repolarization.

V.characteristics: Broad, notched, slurred QRS complex (>120 ms), absent P-wave, prominent discordant inverted T-wave.

F.class_name: Fusion of Ventricular and Normal Beat
F.characteristics: Intermediate QRS duration and amplitude, hybrid vector resulting from simultaneous sinus and ectopic activation.

Q.characteristics: Narrow artificial pacing spike immediately followed by wide, delayed ventricular depolarization complex.
